interpretation.name: ShortLoanNutrunnerToLine2
interpretation.goal: Bring the shared nutrunner NR7 from the crib to station st2, tighten the F30 fasteners with the MES program, evaluate and record the result, and return the tool to the crib so line 3 can reserve it.
constraints: Reserve NR7 for line 2 before any transport or use, and release it when done so line 3's pending request can be granted (E1)
Every transport-tool Step runs on executor agvexecutor (E2)
NR7 must be at station st2 before configure-tool or tighten-fasteners (E3)
The tightening program comes only from get-program for variant F30; no torque or tolerance literals; Steps using it depend on the get-program Step (E4)
Every tightening is evaluated against its program and recorded (E5)
Every tool-using Step depends on the reserve-tool Step to renew the lease (E6)
The 120 s lease exceeds every single tool-using Step: transport 90 s, tighten 60 s, configure 5 s (E9)
interpretation.preference: Keep NR7 away from the crib as briefly as possible: get the program before the outbound transport, start the return transport right after tightening, run evaluation and recording in parallel with the return, and release the tool as soon as it is back in the crib.
interpretation.horizon: Current request only (one tightening job on line 2, then hand-over to line 3)
